# Contract: Project Configuration Schema

Single human-editable file at `.security-scan/config.yaml` (FR-023). Strictly validated before any scan work (FR-026): invalid values or conflicting settings abort the scan with all problems reported at once. Machine-specific values may be overridden by environment variables (`SECSCAN_<SECTION>_<KEY>`); secrets are env-only (FR-025).

```yaml
# .security-scan/config.yaml — generated by `security-scan init`
version: 1

workspace:                      # optional (FR-001c); auto-discovery if omitted
  members:
    - { name: payments, path: ../payments-service }
    - { name: orders,   path: ../orders-service }
  integrations:                 # declared integration points (typed)
    - { from: orders, to: payments, type: sync-api, endpoints: ["POST /payments"] }

llm:
  mode: auto                    # auto (agent-mediated if no endpoint) | endpoint | agent
  endpoint:                     # optional; presence switches analysis to external endpoint (FR-027)
    provider: anthropic         # anthropic | openai-compatible
    model_map:                  # model tiers per analysis level (FR-008a)
      local: claude-haiku-*
      segment: claude-sonnet-*
      system: claude-opus-*
    api_key_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY   # env var NAME only — never the value (FR-025)

execution_policy:               # per-scan overridable (FR-007a)
  mode: interactive             # interactive | batch-offpeak
  offpeak_window: "02:00-06:00" # required when mode=batch-offpeak (else conflict error)
  batch: { enabled: false, fallback: interactive }   # fallback mandated (FR-016b)

budgets:                        # token budgets per invocation (FR-007)
  max_context_tokens: 12000
  max_output_tokens: 3000
  escalation_threshold: 0.75

profiles:                       # custom profiles (FR-028); built-ins: quick/full/audit
  ci-triage:
    base: quick
    report_thresholds: { min_severity_band: High, min_confidence: 0.6 }

scanners:                       # adapter enablement (FR-009)
  semgrep: { enabled: auto }    # auto = run if detected
  gitleaks: { enabled: auto }
  osv: { enabled: auto }
  trivy: { enabled: auto }

redaction:                      # extends built-in rules (research.md R5)
  extra_patterns: []
```

## Validation rules

1. `execution_policy.mode=batch-offpeak` requires `offpeak_window` (conflict → refuse to start).
2. `llm.endpoint` present ⇒ `api_key_env` required and must name an *existing* environment variable at scan time; absent ⇒ agent-mediated mode (never an error).
3. In agent-mediated mode, endpoint-only settings (`batch`, `offpeak_window`, `model_map`) are reported as unavailable — not silently ignored (spec Q2).
4. `budgets.*` must be positive integers; `escalation_threshold` in (0, 1].
5. Unknown keys are rejected (strict schema) with the expected key path in the message.
6. Profile references (`profiles.*.base`, `--profile`) must resolve to built-in or defined custom profiles.
